messages:
Nora: quick thread for Tues webinar ops. owners needed: reg page copy, consent, zoom backup, replay CTA.
Ezra: I'll take Zoom + backups. plan: cloud record + local host + OBS->S3 RTMP as fallback. will run RTMP test in greenroom.
Lina: I'll own HubSpot mapping and the 3-email nurture sequence. need GDPR wording for EU registrants.
Tom: I'll prep announcement copy + 3 short clip scripts. aim to have social assets ready within 24h.
LegalBot: Consent guidance: opt-in required. propose: "I consent to follow-up communications and short event highlights for marketing." show privacy link on reg page.
Nora: timeline: event Wed 9am PT. Post-event: raw upload within 3h, first clip within 24h, replay email within 4h. agree?
Lina: agree. HubSpot fields: email, name, company, role, timezone, marketing_consent, benchmark_opt_in. set static list: webinar:tues-2026.
Ezra: runbook excerpt: start cloud recording, start local host recording, start OBS RTMP-> s3/webinars/tmp. if cloud missing SRT, run speech2text (whisper-large).
Tom: CTA on replay page: "Request a live demo" button that creates a HubSpot task for SDR if clicked.
Nora: final checklist before greenroom: reg copy (Lina), consent text (LegalBot), zoom config + RTMP test (Ezra), social copy (Tom). greenroom 30m prior. thanks!
